text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trai~ner!
Thanks for giving me the day off~☆
choice_data_list: Did you get to refresh yourself?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I rewatched the entire
"Classic Sumo Bouts Collection," and it was so fun!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I know! Next time, I'd really love to go
watch live sumo wrestling with you, Trainer~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It looks like Hishi Akebono got plenty of rest.
